note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. Only the supplied relationships are drawn, each in its kind's style: a plain relation never gets an arrow, and a causal link appears only when the author supplies it. Both cards have the same size, stroke and ink; neither is marked right, wrong or valid. No rule, time limit, outcome or jurisdiction is drawn.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Default: four supplied relationships (two plain relations, two sequences), the tracer goes intake → card B → position → card A → history; the position enlarges.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: other relationships — a communication between the history pocket and the position is added, card B is only related (not sequenced) to the intake — another traversal order (history first) and the history pocket as the focus element.
